accepted_baseline: v0.9.0-rc.2 plus hardware-tested Linux 6.18.38 compatibility port

fpga.sources: Matching FPGA, RTL, MIF, constraints and project files in this tree; embedded build date 260930-LR2 retained. Host sources are separately authoritative. No FPGA rebuild for packaging.

host.behavior_change: Release version label only; all other frontend binary bytes except GNU build ID unchanged from the tested beta.

wc_module.source_note: Original 5.15 binary retained; common source has a version-gated Linux 6.3+ VMA flags API.

publication_status: Local release candidate; publication requires user approval.

validation.hardware: Linux 6.18.38 beta: normal module load/unload, restricted mmap boundaries and publication pixel readback passed. NSMB title, Castlevania opening movie and 512 MiB Pokemon White 2 intro advanced with zero fault samples in their 20-second captures. Three clean exits restored normal MiSTer and original clock/boost settings. Relauch with unloaded clock driver passed. Runtime clock was 1 GHz; no recorded time at 1.2 GHz. In-level speed, audio and controller responsiveness were not measured in these checks.
validation.host: 34 Python launcher/clock tests, 10 package audit controls and two focused menu suites pass. Release host differs from tested beta only in its version label and GNU build ID.
validation.packaging: Public source and archive audits, internal/outer checksums, modes and component identities required before readiness; no user BIOS, firmware, ROMs, saves or settings included.
